content: alexcrichton removed the review request for wasmtime-core-reviewers from PR #15021.

alexcrichton opened PR #15021 from alexcrichton:optimize-fuzz to bytecodealliance:main:

The previous per-byte comparison didn't optimize with sanitizers, but this commit changes it to a slice comparison which does optimize to memcmp. Locally this is ~120x faster for a test case that otherwise timed out.
